narrative.headline: Top 50 tape skews decisively bullish — 26 of 50 names tilt long with heavy dark pool conviction across mega-cap tech, financials, and staples, against a stubborn 18-name bearish pocket led by LLY, MSFT, and AMD.
bullish_setups: WMT: perfect 10.0 composite — flow 10.0 + $602M dark pool accumulation
GOOGL: $44.8M call premium + $2.41B dark pool (largest in scan) + max blocks
COST: 9.38 flow + $284M dark pool + 9.78 blocks — staples leadership confirmed
CSCO/AMAT: both 9.32 flow with 10.0 dark pool — semis & networking quietly accumulated ($395M / $907M DP)
ORCL: $26.3M near-money call premium + $280M dark pool — AI infra bid persists
AAPL: $46M call premium + $1.43B dark pool, max blocks — institutional re-engagement
META: $22.7M flow + $1.65B dark pool — second-largest DP footprint
WFC/C/AXP: financials cluster with 9.2–10.0 flow scores — clear sector accumulation
bearish_setups: LLY: flow 4.16 despite max DP/blocks — distribution into size, healthcare leader breaking
MSFT: flow 3.78 — notable divergence vs GOOGL/META/AAPL bullish cluster
AMD: flow 4.01 against bullish NVDA-adjacent semis (INTC, AMAT) — idiosyncratic weakness
PLTR: flow 3.62 — momentum name seeing put-side pressure
GS: flow 3.43 — diverges sharply from WFC/C/AXP bullish financial tape
CAT/GE: industrials weak (flow 4.03 / 1.67) despite heavy block activity
V: flow 1.87 — weakest payments read, contrasts AXP strength
narrative.rotation_signal: Accumulation is concentrated in mega-cap tech ex-MSFT/AMD (GOOGL, META, AAPL, ORCL, CSCO, AMAT, INTC), consumer staples/retail (WMT, COST, HD), and money-center banks (WFC, C, AXP). Distribution is clearest in healthcare leadership (LLY, ABBV, JNJ ex), high-beta momentum (PLTR, AMD), and select industrials (CAT, GE) — a quality-tech-plus-banks rotation against momentum and defensives.
narrative.diverging_from_industry_layer: MSFT bearish while GOOGL/META/AAPL all rank top-15 bullish — rare intra-mega-cap-tech split. AMD bearish while INTC and AMAT post 9.59 composites — semis read is name-specific, not sector-wide. GS bearish against a uniformly bullish bank complex (WFC, C, AXP) — investment banking diverging from commercial/consumer finance.
